# 🚦 quality-gates

Quality contracts, change gates, waivers, release readiness, metrics and debt.

Install: `quality-gates@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

📘 **Guide:** [Quality governance](guides/quality-governance.md) shows how the pieces work together.

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`derive-quality-contract`](skills/derive-quality-contract/SKILL.md): Derive a quality contract
- [`scope-change-gate`](skills/scope-change-gate/SKILL.md): Scope and gate this change
- [`record-change-intent`](skills/record-change-intent/SKILL.md): Record the intent behind a change
- [`audit-quality-debt`](skills/audit-quality-debt/SKILL.md): Audit quality debt and silent skips
